Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high fidelity desktop website screenshot for GoSendeet, a Nigerian delivery comparison service, mockup 1 of 10. Landscape 1440x1000-ish composition, flat front-on website screenshot with no device frame. Direction: 01 Quiet centered: centered two-line headline, compact unified horizontal form, plain white canvas, immaculate contemporary sans serif spacing, small photo route cards below.
Retain recognizable GoSendeet brand, deep green #064e3b and solid mid green accents, charcoal text. Contemporary polished 2026 consumer product design with realistic understated typography, not dated corporate web design and not generic AI landing page styling.
Content: header GoSendeet wordmark at left; navigation Get a quote, Track a delivery, About us, Developer; Sign up and Sign in at right. Main headline EXACT "A simpler way" line break "to send." Supporting text EXACT "Compare delivery prices in one place. Choose a courier, book your delivery and follow its progress."
Visible explicit mode labels "Compare prices" and "Track a delivery". Functional-looking booking form with Pickup address, Destination address, Package, and solid green "Compare prices" button. Pickup/destination placeholders "Enter pickup address" / "Enter destination address". Package "Small parcel". Small INLINE text actions "Enter manually" and "Use location" below address fields. Modest 6–10px radii, clear borders, no giant pills. No trust slogan badges or eyebrow. No gradients, glows, puzzle backgrounds, floating 3D boxes, fake stats, decorative icon carpets or large illustrations.
Below hero show "Where are you sending today?" and a row of THREE COMPACT photo route cards (about 190–220px wide, image about 110–130px tall). First card "Ikeja to Lekki" with "From ₦2,000". Other cards "Yaba to Victoria Island" and "Lagos to Ibadan" with "Compare prices" as secondary caption (do not invent other fares). Small natural Lagos/Ibadan city or bridge photos. Airbnb reference applies only to compact photo route presets. Wakanow reference applies only to practical booking form organization. Keep page recognizably a delivery site, do not copy their colors or hotel/travel content. Show enough lower content to evaluate section spacing. Tiny unobtrusive label "Concept 01" near bottom edge. Excellent text accuracy, coherent spacing, restrained real product UI.
